title: Cauim Crumble Flaky Pie
description: A unique dessert featuring fermented cauim and flaky crust, topped with crumble and a touch of tropical flair from Brazil.

ingredients.name: Flaky Pastry Crust
ingredients.notes: make sure to thaw overnight in the fridge

ingredients.name: Cauim
ingredients.notes: fermented, strain and rinse before use

ingredients.name: Brazilian Honey
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a vegan alternative

ingredients.name: Fresh Berries
ingredients.notes: strawberries, blueberries, or raspberries work well

instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry crust and place in a pie dish.
Strain and rinse the cauim, then mix with the Brazilian honey in a bowl.
Add the cauim mixture to the pie crust, leaving a 1-inch border.
Top with the crumble topping and fresh berries.
Drizzle with coconut oil and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
